s006 ἀχειροποιήτῳ → not made with hands headed on hands is the verse's contested head and is properly hedged in the unit note. Rule 84's line is the nearest precedent — the negative word spells the privative prefix and the complement carries the lexeme — and thirteen corpus units head such a phrase on the noun. Heading on made, the verbal root of χειροποίητος, remains defensible.
s009 ἀπεκδύσει → putting off keeps the preverb particle inside the unit under rule 106, headed on the word glossing the root.

s005 περιτομῇ takes both the case preposition and the supplied indefinite as helpers because the Greek is anarthrous (rules 21 and 51's anarthrous clause), while s008 and s015 take their own the as articles.
